headline: Kai, the energy shock is now a Fed problem — oil closed above $100, inflation is back at 3.7 percent, and markets put December hike odds near 89 percent.
subline: The Nasdaq lost 4.5 percent for the week on AI-debt worries, No Kings rallies hit 22 states today, and Netflix, Tesla and Meta report next week.
asof: Saturday edition · strip is Friday's close (Oct 16), bitcoin early Saturday · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Gas at a record $4.33 drives CPI to 3.7
items.sentence: September headline inflation ran 3.7 percent against 3.6 expected as pump prices hit a record $4.33 a gallon and core ticked up to 2.6, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Warsh stays silent; December hike odds near 89 percent
items.sentence: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gave no rate signal at the IMF meetings, and traders now put the odds of an October 28 hike around 15 percent with December near 89, per Kitco.

items.title: Oil tops $100 as Iran presses Hormuz
items.sentence: WTI rose 3.4 percent Friday to $101.35 and Brent 3.5 to $109.55 on Middle East supply risk, per Yahoo Finance's closing wrap.

items.title: Bitcoin rides out the week's rate shock
items.sentence: It trades at $81,358 early Saturday, down 0.7 percent over 24 hours but steady against a dollar at a 17-month high, per Coin Gabbar, which flags bitcoin's record-tight correlation with 10-year real yields.

items.title: Next week: Netflix Tuesday, Tesla and Meta Wednesday
items.sentence: Netflix reports after Tuesday's close and Tesla and Meta after Wednesday's, per StockTitan's calendar, the first hard test of whether AI spending shows up as earnings.

items.title: No Kings returns today with early-voting push
items.sentence: Organizers planned 'No Kings: Vote Early' rallies in 22 states for Saturday — more than 40 events in Colorado alone — to drive turnout ahead of the midterms, per Wikipedia's running entry.

items.title: War has rewired two chokepoints of world trade
items.sentence: CNN examines how the US-Iran war has upended shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb, the two routes behind oil's climb past $100.

items.title: Trump vows no new Iran strikes before midterms
items.sentence: The pledge to hold off until after the election failed to soothe oil markets, per NBC News.

items.title: Gaza braces for winter as attacks continue
items.sentence: UN News reports Gaza bracing for winter amid ongoing attacks, while a separate Security Council briefing cites a spike in deaths and demolitions in Gaza and the West Bank.

items.title: Israel's PM promises 'emphatically' to curb settler violence
items.sentence: Israel's ambassador says the prime minister has made an emphatic commitment to rein in settler attacks, per the Times of Israel's Friday liveblog.

items.title: The AI trade cracks on CoreWeave's debt
items.sentence: CoreWeave fell another 12 percent Friday on worries about its roughly $50 billion debt load, dragging the Nasdaq to a 4.5 percent weekly loss, while Jensen Huang insisted Nvidia needs no backstop, per TheStreet.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO price talk slips to $1.5 trillion
items.sentence: Some investors are pushing the November listing's valuation down from $2 trillion after quarterly revenue of $16.8 billion grew 45 percent sequentially, slower than hoped, per Yahoo Finance on Reuters reporting.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon arrives with hallucinations at 15 percent
items.sentence: Google's new flagship is generally available, scoring a 15 percent hallucination rate to GPT-6 Astra's 51 in one benchmark, per Russ McGuire's AI News.

items.title: White House superintelligence task force starts the clock
items.sentence: The task force adopted its charter and opened a 120-day window for a risk report on cybersecurity, biosecurity and model control, chaired by DNI Jay Clayton, per AI Weekly.

items.title: FTC sends OpenAI and Anthropic 50-page demands
items.sentence: The agency issued both labs civil investigative demands over AI safety incidents, per AI Weekly's roundup.
